title: Zesty Crispy Filipino Flat Rice Noodles
description: A festive Filipino dish featuring fermented flat rice noodles, crispy and low in calories, perfect for snacking. It is traditionally served on a bamboo tray.

ingredients.name: long-fermentation-dough
ingredients.notes: allow to ferment for at least 24 hours

instructions: Soak the flat rice noodles in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain the noodles and cut them into desired lengths.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the fermented dough and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Add the cooked noodles, salt, and black pepper, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Squeeze the calamansi juice over the noodles and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the noodles to a bamboo tray and garnish with chopped green onions.
